season_garden_19_001.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_001.text: The nineteenth afternoon began with the hall worker setting out only the small materials the helpers had actually used. The current instructions, loose practice board and general stock list lay on the supported table. Heavier bundles remained for staff to handle. Yue had expected a larger heap and felt relieved when the finite scope became visible. Qiu checked the receiver's current list before opening her own folder. Tomorrow's final handover would not collect every object they had cared about, only the useful materials and records whose custody their agreement actually required.

season_garden_19_002.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_002.text: The responsible worker confirmed the current arrangements before the helpers touched anything. The ordinary shelf places still matched the revised sheet, and the loose practice methods remained within the accepted small tasks. The final receiver check would occur tomorrow under current conditions. Today the women would prepare the finite packet and complete ordinary assigned maintenance. Yue kept her shoulder supported. Qiu placed the practice board within her elbow's comfortable range. Neither increased her movements because the end was close or because the objects looked too small to justify another clear limit.

season_garden_19_003.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_003.text: Their first assignment was to compare the inventory with the physical small stock. Qiu read each accepted name while Yue indicated the corresponding item without lifting larger stacks. The permitted summary copy already released to its receiver appeared as an authorized release, with its source conditions attached. It did not appear as missing stock to be replaced. The worker checked the actual count. Blank practice sheets returned to their ordinary tray, and no private correspondence or patient form entered the list merely because it had once passed through the same room.

season_garden_19_004.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_004.text: The loose practice board retained its shallow ordinary scratch. The receiver still judged its accepted small use suitable and wanted the current condition noted plainly. Yue wrote the description without adding a promise to repair or replace it. Qiu wanted to polish the surface until the scratch seemed less visible. The worker said no further finish was needed. The board would continue as an ordinary practice object under its owner's assessment. The helpers' wish to return something immaculate did not create an obligation to remove evidence of normal use.

season_garden_19_005.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_005.text: They checked the removable cloth samples against the approved care instruction. One loose piece had been folded before it was fully dry during an ordinary duty. The responsible worker had already set it in the specified waiting place. Yue recorded the relevant general event without identifying the person who had handled it. Qiu checked the instruction's existing distinction between a loose damp piece and a folded stack. The words still addressed the case. A later imperfect action did not prove the accepted instruction useless or authorize the writers to evaluate a user's private abilities.

season_garden_19_006.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_006.text: The worker asked whether the drying sentence needed more emphasis. Yue proposed a heavier heading, and Qiu proposed repeating the line near the end. The responsible person preferred checking the current placement first. A willing worker found the sentence easily from the usual position and said she had simply been interrupted in that earlier duty. No private details of the interruption were needed. The instruction remained unchanged for current use. Yue crossed out the extra heading in her draft. The sheet did not need to grow whenever ordinary life prevented someone from following it.

season_garden_19_007.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_007.text: The chosen teaching format still supplied the actual source of the handover. The women would represent that format tomorrow through its real setting and practical observations. They had not performed the alternative as an extra favor. Qiu put the source reminder beside the receiver's final question list, clearly outside the public instruction. Yue checked the decision's actual selected destination in the work record. The delayed final account would use that remembered work, rather than a general claim that both ways of teaching had produced the same accepted result.

season_garden_19_008.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_008.text: Su arrived to confirm the treasury record's planned final review. The labor allocation was one hundred twenty copper, separate from forty for materials. Today would bring each helper to fifty six actual hours if the full session completed. Tomorrow's full session would bring each to fifty nine, with the earlier storm's one unfinished hour still absent. No free makeup had occurred or been promised. The women's ordinary food, paper and family expenses stayed outside the allowance. Yue was glad the arithmetic had remained simple while the season's personal meaning had not.

season_garden_19_009.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_009.text: A family member came through to ask the hall worker an ordinary question and noticed the neat packet. She asked whether the helpers were finishing. Yue said their accepted twentieth session was planned for tomorrow and the professional staff would retain the useful materials afterward. The woman nodded and did not ask them to stay. Qiu felt how easily she had been preparing to refuse an imagined extension. The actual response was ordinary recognition of an end. The family member's private needs stayed with her own question rather than becoming another assignment attached to farewell.

season_garden_19_010.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_010.text: The cook needed a general label replaced on the ordinary cup shelf. The responsible worker supplied the approved wording and existing blank stock. Yue copied the small label from her supported position, while Qiu checked its legibility and current name. Staff handled final placement. The task was useful and unrelated to the final packet's emotional weight. Yue liked having one ordinary current problem to solve. It did not reopen the term or authorize a redesign of the kitchen, and no new material purchase followed from the replacement of worn paper.

season_garden_19_011.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_011.text: Once the label was placed, a willing ordinary user found the cup shelf without asking either helper. The worker retained that limited observation. Qiu did not follow the person to collect praise or measure the improvement. Yue kept the superseded general label in the authorized return stock until the worker specified its disposal. The current practical paper and its old version had separate destinations. A small successful use could remain visible in the record without becoming a claim that every future visitor would find the place equally easy to understand.

season_garden_19_012.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_012.text: At the first agreed pause, Yue stepped to the permitted view with her own notebook closed. Qiu chose a comfortable place for her elbow and watched the ordinary garden movement. Staff continued their work around the selected planting, which followed its accepted care arrangement regardless of the helpers' presence. Farther along the permitted view stood the established orchard plum owned and cared for separately. It was intact and already grown, unlike the young selected stock in the plum history. In the annual history it remained the same owner's ordinary tree, beyond that different selected bed.

season_garden_19_013.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_013.text: The bench owner approached with one dry leaf resting on a clean household scrap she had brought herself. She said it had fallen naturally from her intact established plum and she had picked it up from the place she was permitted to tend. No branch had been cut or leaf pulled from the living tree. She offered this one fallen leaf to Yue for a private keepsake if Yue wanted it. The offer concerned that actual owned object and private use, not a public exhibit or a medicinal preparation.

season_garden_19_014.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_014.text: Yue asked whether the owner truly wanted to give the leaf away rather than keep it with her own things. The woman said she did, and that the tree supplied more sweeping than her household needed. Qiu laughed at the familiar complaint. Yue accepted the one naturally fallen leaf with thanks. Its permission did not include the owner's private family account, the grandmother's papers or any right to take more material from the orchard. A small real gift could have a clear boundary and still feel generous to the person receiving it.

season_garden_19_015.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_015.text: The owner said the leaf came from the established plum she had mentioned yesterday. It was separate from Yue's selected annual bed or young plum, and neither possible planting history had produced this mature leaf for her. Yue appreciated the distinction. The season had offered something through another person's ordinary life, without making it a prize for choosing correctly. Qiu looked at the intact tree from the permitted view. The owner returned to her own route after the offer, leaving no request that the helpers preserve her words or tell a public story about the gift.

season_garden_19_016.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_016.text: Yue carried the fallen leaf back to her own supported place. She checked that her notebook contained a clean blank private page and no other person's paper. Qiu steadied the notebook only after Yue asked for that small assistance within her comfortable elbow movement. Yue laid the single leaf flat between the clean pages and closed them gently. She used no garden stock, press expense or hidden labor allocation. The actual pressing began in her private notebook, where the leaf would remain a personal keepsake rather than entering the staff handover packet.

season_garden_19_017.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_017.text: The dry leaf had a small tear at one edge. Yue did not trim it to produce a perfect shape or ask the owner for another. Qiu said the missing edge made it easier to recognize. Yue agreed and wrote a brief private note on the adjacent page: one naturally fallen leaf, offered by its owner from the intact established plum. She made no medical claim and recorded no private family history. The note concerned the gift she had actually received. The notebook stayed hers, separate from the general instructions staff would accept.

season_garden_19_018.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_018.text: Yue felt the temptation to call the leaf a sign that the garden approved their work. She said so quietly to Qiu. Qiu answered that the owner had offered a leaf, and the leaf had not spoken for the whole season. Yue laughed and let the smaller truth remain. The object could carry a private association without becoming evidence of professional competence or a cure for grief. The owner had given permission for a keepsake. That real offer was enough reason for Yue to keep it, with no public meaning required.

season_garden_19_019.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_019.text: Qiu asked whether Yue wanted the leaf shown to anyone else. Yue said she preferred to keep it in the notebook for herself. The owner's permission had not asked for display, and no public copy would be made. Qiu accepted the answer without teasing her into sharing. Her own untested drawing stayed in her private folder, equally outside the accepted methods. Each woman could retain a personal draft or keepsake without giving the receiver another object to evaluate. The useful handover would remain useful because it contained only the materials actually within its scope.

season_garden_19_020.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_020.text: The leaf rested between the clean pages while Yue drank during the remainder of the pause. Her shoulder needed the same supported rest as before the gift. No private keepsake altered her medical situation or gave her authority to advise someone else's body. Qiu kept her elbow comfortable and let the notebook remain closed. Their ordinary limits continued beside the moment's pleasure. Yue liked that the gift had not demanded a new version of herself. She could accept it as the woman who still needed rest and still had tomorrow's finite work to complete.

season_garden_19_021.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_021.text: When the pause ended, Yue placed the notebook among her own belongings, away from the working stock. The leaf was actually retained there under the offered private permission. Qiu checked that no page of the notebook had been included in the general packet. The responsible worker received only the current task materials when work resumed. Patient records, the child's drawing and pinwheel remained with their owners and absent fresh permission. The single offered leaf did not create a general exception for private things the women wished they could carry home from the garden.

season_garden_19_022.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_022.text: Their next task was to review the general method packet's first page. The scope named approved loose cloth and general stock tasks, current staff ownership and the consultation route. Yue checked that no phrase implied the helpers would continue answering after the twentieth session. Qiu checked that the public sheet did not include the receiver's internal question list. That list guided tomorrow's current acceptance and belonged separately to the professional worker. The shared practical methods could remain available without turning their final check into a public certificate or a standing promise of support.

season_garden_19_023.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_023.text: The worker asked for a clearer distinction between the public current instruction and the retained comparison copy. Yue proposed two plain labels on existing stock. Qiu compared the dates and wrote the appropriate current and comparison words. The receiver approved the practical separation and handled the folder placement. No private original was relabeled as a general example. No clinical exercise sheet entered the packet. The current method would be the one users found, while the comparison material stayed available to staff for its actual maintenance purpose rather than competing on the display.

season_garden_19_024.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_024.text: A willing worker used the current release instruction with the loose practice object. She paused at the fixed support, released the permitted cloth part and placed it according to the drying note. Yue read without adding gestures. Qiu kept her hands away from the object. The responsible worker observed and retained the limited result. The method had been followed in this setting with this object. It did not authorize the helpers to teach heavier supports or promise every future reader would find the wording equally clear without consultation.

season_garden_19_025.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_025.text: The worker then asked the reader to locate the general paper ownership caution. She found it and said she would ask the responsible worker before guessing where a person's paper should go. Yue recorded that specific answer without making it an assessment of the reader's character. Qiu left participant names out because the task record did not require them. The useful point concerned the instruction's visible boundary. The women had learned to prefer that modest evidence over a dramatic declaration that the room's information was now protected by their careful sheet.

season_garden_19_026.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_026.text: One current sentence still used the old drying place in a parenthetical note. Qiu found it during the full read and marked it before handover. Yue felt embarrassed that the main line's correction had left the small note behind. The responsible worker approved replacing the obsolete name with the current one. The revised sheet received its actual date. A hidden dependency had been found through another real check. The women corrected it rather than covering the error with an assertion that the accepted method had already been tested enough times to deserve trust.

season_garden_19_027.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_027.text: They checked every other place name against the current staff arrangement. The return tray, blank stock place and waiting section matched. The general consultation route still named the responsible role. No other current contradiction appeared in this finite review. Yue wrote those specific checks in the practical record. Qiu resisted adding an assurance that there were no contradictions anywhere. The receiver would retain authority to revise when ordinary use or site conditions changed. Today's useful accuracy did not require a promise that tomorrow could produce no new question.

season_garden_19_028.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_028.text: The staff worker carried the larger sample bundle to its storage place. Yue and Qiu returned only the small loose pieces assigned to them. Yue had felt tempted to take the bundle because there was only one day left. She stated her shoulder limit instead. Qiu stated her elbow limit before reaching for another piece. The staff accepted both and completed their own handling. Their term's end did not turn a bodily boundary into an inconvenience the women had to conceal. Professional healers retained medical decisions, and the actual work stayed within the accepted practical capacity.

season_garden_19_029.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_029.text: At the next pause, Qiu asked how Yue wanted to remember the whole season. Yue said she did not yet know. The pressed leaf gave her a private object, but it did not summarize the grandmother, the repaired bench, the chosen planting or their arguments. Qiu said her unfinished drawing also seemed unable to hold everything she wanted. Neither proposed making the other's private page more complete. They sat with the ordinary sounds of the hall. A personal record could leave things missing without making the missing parts proof that the person had failed to care.

season_garden_19_030.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_030.text: Yue said she had once expected the grandmother's death to make every remaining session solemn. The cook's complaints and the owner's sweeping joke had repeatedly interrupted that expectation. Qiu said ordinary irritation did not insult a person who had died. Yue knew that intellectually and still felt a small disloyalty when she laughed. Qiu did not cure the feeling by arguing it away. They let it accompany the pause. The family's own private grief remained theirs, and the helpers' uncertainty remained a personal response rather than a condition the public instructions needed to resolve.

season_garden_19_031.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_031.text: Qiu checked her family calendar before agreeing to an ordinary visit after the term. Her sister wanted company on a day that allowed rest afterward, and Qiu had offered the time she could actually manage. Yue checked the family invitation already on her own calendar. Neither turned the end of paid work into a vow to make herself available to everyone else. The finite garden agreement would release particular hours. Their relationships would still require actual invitations, choices and limits, with no general grant of one woman's remaining life to another person's need.

season_garden_19_032.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_032.text: Su asked whether any current materials remained in the helpers' homes. Yue had her private notebook and ordinary personal paper, with no borrowed staff originals. Qiu had her untested private drawing and personal notes, with no accepted hall stock she needed to bring back. The permitted general reminders they had copied were limited to their own planning and carried no patient information. The worker's current originals stayed at the site. Su recorded the actual custody point for closure, rather than asking them to produce every private thought as evidence that the handover was complete.

season_garden_19_033.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_033.text: The leaf would remain in Yue's private notebook after the term. She told Su only that no garden stock had been taken home without permission, not the private meaning she was still deciding it had. Qiu smiled at the closed notebook and did not volunteer the owner's conversation for the general record. The actual gift required no treasury adjustment. It had been one naturally fallen owned leaf, freely offered for private keeping from the intact established plum. No medicinal promise, plant damage or claim on the selected planting accompanied its custody.

season_garden_19_034.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_034.text: When work resumed, the responsible worker asked the women to check the final receiver question list against the actual packet. Each practical question now had an object or record to inspect. The current places could be compared with the sheet. The ownership caution could be found. The loose method could be tried with the accepted practice piece. Superseded copies could be accounted for. Yue removed a vague question about whether the packet felt complete. Qiu said the receiver could accept or request a specific correction without being asked to endorse the writers' feelings.

season_garden_19_035.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_035.text: The list stayed separate from the public instruction and would be held by the receiver. Its purpose was a current finite acceptance check, not a new standing review duty assigned to the helpers. Staff retained their professional authority and their own records. Yue copied no private form into the general packet to demonstrate exclusion. Qiu specified the permitted materials that were actually present and the authorized releases already completed. The list could be precise through positive custody facts. It did not need a catalogue of every private thing the women had encountered and left alone.

season_garden_19_036.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_036.text: The gardener passed through to confirm that tomorrow's selected planting account would use the actual receipt and care record. The annual or young plum history would remain distinct, with no extra purchase planned. The gardener retained the trained growth judgment and ongoing rota. Yue asked whether the twentieth observation would need the helpers to touch the plants. It would not. They would copy a permitted current general summary from the responsible record. Qiu put the gauge away. The source decision remained alive because the real living uses, costs and final statements differed.

season_garden_19_037.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_037.text: The established owner's plum remained separate from that final planting account. Its naturally fallen offered leaf was not a purchase from the forty copper material allocation or a harvest from the selected young stock. Yue checked the private note once during the agreed pause, then closed the notebook again. The distinction kept the gift honest across both possible histories. Qiu said it was pleasant to have received something they had not planned. Yue agreed. An ordinary owner's generosity could enter her private life without rewriting the project's receipts or making its alternatives equivalent.

season_garden_19_038.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_038.text: A household user asked whether the final instructions could stay where she usually found them. The responsible worker said the current placement was retained under her own maintenance authority, subject to later actual changes. Yue did not promise permanence. Qiu pointed to the staff consultation line after permission. The woman read it and went on with her ordinary task. The encounter supplied one useful question about continuing access. It did not require the helpers to announce an ending to every person who used the sheet or collect statements proving their contribution would be remembered.

season_garden_19_039.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_039.text: The general paper return tray contained a privately owned item awaiting its authorized receiver. The responsible worker handled it through the proper process while the helpers checked blank stock elsewhere. Yue did not inspect the contents or list it among their materials. Qiu kept the current instruction face up so the ownership caution remained available. The women's work could support appropriate consultation without acquiring the private paper. Its actual custody belonged to staff and the owner. The final packet would not include a copy merely because the paper had illustrated why the caution mattered.

season_garden_19_040.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_040.text: The blank stock count now matched the list, including the permitted released summary recorded separately. Qiu read it aloud and Yue checked each assigned small item. The worker accepted the prepared list for tomorrow's current check. Staff would carry heavier materials, and no further personal object needed to be returned by the helpers. Yue looked at her own notebook among her belongings and felt the leaf's small private weight in the closed pages. The distinction between keeping and handing over no longer required every thing to have the same destination in order to feel cared for.

season_garden_19_041.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_041.text: The worker asked them to prepare the current method packet for ordinary storage overnight. Yue placed the accepted sheet where the receiver specified. Qiu placed the source note and comparison copy in their separate staff folder. The internal question list stayed with the receiver's final check materials. Public current wording would remain accessible to ordinary users in its established place. No untested drawing or private reflection entered the packet. The actual overnight custody belonged to professional staff, who remained at the site and owned the records they would inspect tomorrow.

season_garden_19_042.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_042.text: A small tie in the loose stock had frayed through ordinary use. The responsible worker inspected it and removed it from current practice under her own material assessment. The helpers recorded its specified return to ordinary waste stock, with no private contents involved. A suitable existing replacement remained available from approved stock. No new purchase occurred. Yue did not mend the fray at home as a farewell favor. Qiu did not retain it as an example for her drawing. The receiver's actual material decision gave the small object a clear completed destination.

season_garden_19_043.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_043.text: The replacement loose tie needed its practice instruction checked for compatibility. The responsible worker confirmed the accepted small method remained appropriate to this existing piece. Qiu performed the permitted movement within her elbow's comfortable range while Yue read. The loop released as described, leaving the fixed practice support untouched. The worker retained that limited observation. Their account named the actual replacement and check without calling the women responsible for future material suitability. Staff would continue deciding when ordinary stock needed another replacement, and the helpers' end date would not weaken that responsibility.

season_garden_19_044.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_044.text: At the final pause, Yue said she was glad the leaf had arrived before the last afternoon. It had given her time to keep it quietly without asking the handover to celebrate it. Qiu said she liked that Yue had accepted the gift without promising to become better at letting go. Yue laughed. The notebook held one leaf and one modest private note. It could not certify a changed person. The useful packet held current general instructions and actual custody records. Neither needed to perform the other's purpose to be worth retaining.

season_garden_19_045.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_045.text: They returned to the remaining ordinary work when the pause ended. The cup label remained legible, the small stock list matched, and the current sheet used the actual drying place in every relevant line. The responsible worker accepted today's finite preparation. Tomorrow she would complete the current receiver check rather than merely inherit the women's assertion that everything was finished. Yue appreciated the distinction even while she wished she could stop being uncertain now. Qiu closed the draft folder after confirming there was no specific correction still assigned for this session.

season_garden_19_046.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_046.text: Su recorded the nineteenth completed full three hour session and paid each helper three copper. Each woman had now worked fifty six hours and received fifty six copper under the new finite agreement. Combined labor spending reached one hundred twelve, leaving eight from the one hundred twenty copper allocation before tomorrow. A full final session would pay six more in total and leave two unused because of the seventh session's unfinished hour. No free makeup or private extension had occurred. The women checked the actual coins and kept them with their own earned money.

season_garden_19_047.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_047.text: The materials account still had no new purchase. The bench repair's six copper and the selected planting's actual three or eight remained its only completed costs. The final branch would state the specific nine or fourteen spent and thirty one or twenty six returned from the forty copper allocation. The leaf did not enter that bill, and ordinary personal paper and food stayed private expenses. Su retained the actual receipts. The arithmetic would close a finite public allowance, not price the grandmother's life, the helpers' grief or an owner's generous private gift.

season_garden_19_048.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_048.text: The worker retained the prepared packet and current small stock in their accepted places. The gardener retained the plant record and care responsibility. Su retained the treasury sheets. Yue took her private notebook with the single offered leaf actually pressed between its clean pages. Qiu took her own folder and untested drawing. Patient forms and family keepsakes had never entered the return packet. The table's clearer surface showed completed ordinary custody, without requiring the women to pretend every feeling had also found a final owner and date.

season_garden_19_049.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_049.text: They checked tomorrow's arrival against their actual plans and current bodily limits. The final three hours would include the receiver's checks, permitted general representations and material returns, with heavier handling assigned to staff. Neither woman offered to arrive early for unpaid preparation. Neither promised to stay late because an ending ought to feel generous. Su accepted the agreed time. The professional workers would assess current conditions as usual. Yue's pressed leaf stayed private, and Qiu's drawing stayed untested, while the public handover waited for the actual final session rather than an imagined smooth conclusion.

season_garden_19_050.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_050.text: The bench owner waved from her ordinary route and asked whether the leaf had fit the notebook. Yue said it had and thanked her again. The woman seemed pleased and then complained about a different ordinary garden thing. Qiu laughed. No further gift was requested or offered. The established plum remained intact under its owner's care. Yue could carry the single fallen leaf away without carrying the tree, its private family meanings or the right to collect another. The small limit made the gift easier to hold without making it less hers.

season_garden_19_051.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_051.text: On the shared walk, Qiu asked whether Yue would bring the notebook tomorrow. Yue said she would, because it was her ordinary private notebook, but would keep it with her belongings. The leaf would not enter the professional staff's general materials or become an illustration in the current method. Qiu agreed. They discussed the last session's practical arrival instead of rehearsing speeches. The farewell priority had already ended at its actual family occasion. This new finite work would finish through current receiver actions, and the women could be moved by that without asking it to repeat a ceremony.

season_garden_19_052.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_052.text: At home, Yue checked the leaf once more and left it between the clean pages to continue pressing. She wrote nothing about the grandmother's private records, the child's drawing or the pinwheel. Those remained with their actual owners. Her note kept the offered leaf's own source and private permission. Then she rested her shoulder according to her own plan. The gift had not made rest unnecessary. It sat quietly in the notebook while ordinary supper, a familiar family voice and the next real date occupied the rest of the evening.

season_garden_19_053.speaker: narrator
season_garden_19_053.text: The twentieth afternoon would close the actual labor and materials account and give the selected handover its final representation. The planting choice still led to different current facts and returned balances, and the knowledge choice still led to the method actually performed. No new choice had been added to blur those histories. Yue put the notebook among her own belongings for the morning. The private leaf remained retained there, while the professional staff held their useful materials overnight. Tomorrow's final work could complete its finite obligations without claiming that every private loss had ended with them.
